rows.grounds: noun; refers to the performed austerity
noun; vocative address to the goddess

items.question: To whom was the account of the austerity reported after Kālī remained unpleased?
premises: Kālī remained unpleased despite severe austerity.
The account of the austerity was reported.
The report was addressed to Śivā.
items.inference: The practitioner turned to Śivā to communicate the outcome of his austerity.
items.plain_english: He then reported the account of his austerity to Śivā.
